verdict.rationale: Jev is an API service, so a sandbox or test environment is a fair question to ask of it. However, the evidence documents no sandbox, test-mode keys, or environment isolated from production. The Playground is an interactive way to try questions, not an isolated environment. The system-one adapter is an LLM-backed drop-in for cost and speed comparison, not a sandbox, so both are only adjacent.

support.subject: As an AI-native user, I can test against a sandbox environment without touching production data
